summary: The note introduces Agni-V, an intercontinental ballistic missile developed by India's Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO). It places the missile within the Agni series, which forms part of the original Integrated Guided Missile Development Program. The note is very brief and gives no specifications, dates, or test history.
one_line: Agni-V is an DRDO-developed Indian intercontinental ballistic missile in the Agni series under the Integrated Guided Missile Development Program.
key_facts: Agni-V is an intercontinental ballistic missile.
Agni-V was developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) of India.
Agni V is part of the Agni series of missiles.
The Agni series is one of the missile systems under the original Integrated Guided Missile Development Program.
